# The Great Product Festival 2026

> India's most inclusive product management conference — 2 days, 4 tracks, 500+ product builders, world-class speakers, hands-on workshops, a 24-hour hackathon, and curated networking. All genders. All levels. All industries.

## About

The Great Product Festival is a Women in Product India initiative. TGPF brings together CPOs, Founders, Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Investors, and Startup Builders for two days of learning, connecting, and building. The conference features keynotes, panels, fireside chats, expert sessions, workshops, roundtables, a hackathon, and networking events.

## Passes

- General: ₹5,499 — Conference access both days, all keynotes, networking, meals
- Premium: ₹9,999 — General + workshops, priority seating, 6-month WiP India membership, swag
- VIP: ₹15,999 — Premium + founders roundtables, VIP dinner, 1-year WiP India membership
